channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: ANAT: Synapse Residency Program 2027 (Australia)
item.description: Australian Network for Art and Technology (ANAT) · deadline 14 Oct 2026 · Total artist fee of AUD 19,250 ex GST plus 12% superannuation, plus up to AUD 3,500 toward other project expenses. No application fee.
